about.title: Our Story
about.heading: The Art of Hospitality & Culinary Passion
about.text: Founded on a deep love for fine taste and culinary traditions, Savora offers signature gastronomy elevating fresh, noble ingredients. Every dish is crafted to awaken your senses in a warm and sophisticated ambiance.
about.quote: « Cooking is about revealing the emotion of every ingredient and creating unforgettable memories for our guests. »
valuesDesc: Minute-precise cooking and harmoniously balanced seasonings.
Rigorous selection from the finest local growers and artisans.
Attentive and discreet service tailored to your special occasions.

reviews.title: What Our Guests Say
reviews.cta: See all reviews on Google Maps

items.name: Marc K.
items.comment: An extraordinary dining experience! The beef tenderloin with truffle jus was tender beyond belief and perfectly cooked. The cozy ambiance is second to none.

items.name: Sarah L.
items.comment: Warm and attentive welcome from the moment we stepped in. The sea bream carpaccio is delightfully fresh, and the cocktail menu is world class.

items.name: Dr. Koffi A.
items.comment: Undoubtedly the premier fine dining restaurant in the city. The wood-grilled lobster and private lounges provide much-appreciated discretion and luxury.

items.name: Emily & Thomas
items.comment: We celebrated our wedding anniversary at Savora. An unforgettable evening, caring staff, and the dark chocolate sphere was an absolute work of art!
